camel_example: aliyun ros StartChat --region cn-hangzhou --Query '创建一个_VPC_和_VSwitch_的_ROS_模板' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Returns agent events through SSE streaming. Supports creating a new session or continuing an existing session
description_zh: 通过SSE流式返回智能体事件，支持创建新会话或继续已有会话
kebab_example: aliyun ros start-chat --query '创建一个_VPC_和_VSwitch_的_ROS_模板' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartChat

parameters.example: 创建一个 VPC 和 VSwitch 的 ROS 模板
parameters.help_en: The user input. The value cannot be empty or contain only whitespace characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户输入，不能为空或仅包含空白字符
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: If this parameter is not specified, a new session is created. If this parameter is specified, the existing session of the current user is continued
parameters.help_zh: 不传则创建新会话；传入则继续当前用户已有会话
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: A compatibility field. V2 always returns event streams through SSE. The current service does not consume this field
parameters.help_zh: 兼容字段。V2 始终通过 SSE 返回事件流，当前服务不消费该字段
parameters.name: enable_partial_message

parameters.help_en: V2 supports only IaCCodeNormal or IaCCodePipeline. The default value for a new session is IaCCodeNormal. An existing session cannot switch modes
parameters.help_zh: V2 仅支持 IaCCodeNormal 或 IaCCodePipeline；新会话默认 IaCCodeNormal，已有会话不能切换模式
parameters.name: mode

fields.help_en: The image media type. Valid values: image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, and image/gif
fields.help_zh: 图片媒体类型，支持 image/png、image/jpeg、image/webp、image/gif
fields.name: mime_type

fields.help_en: The attachment file name. If this parameter is not specified, the file name is obtained from OssObjectKey
fields.help_zh: 附件文件名；不传时从 OssObjectKey 获取文件名
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The OSS object key under the current user directory. The value cannot contain absolute paths or path traversal
fields.help_zh: 当前用户目录下的 OSS object key，不能包含绝对路径或路径穿越
fields.name: oss_object_key

fields.help_en: The attachment type. V2 currently supports only image
fields.help_zh: 附件类型。V2 当前只支持 image
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: V2 does not support direct URL upload. Use OssObjectKey instead
fields.help_zh: V2 暂不支持 URL 直传，请使用 OssObjectKey
fields.name: url

parameters.help_en: The array of image attachments. A maximum of 5 attachments are supported. Currently, only the image type is supported
parameters.help_zh: 图片附件数组，最多 5 个；当前仅支持 image 类型
parameters.name: attachments

parameters.help_en: Set this parameter to V2 to route requests to the ROS Agent V2 backend
parameters.help_zh: 传 V2 路由到 ROS Agent V2 后端
parameters.name: agent_version

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output thinking content. Default value: true. This parameter can be reset per request when re-entering the same session
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出 thinking 内容，默认 true；同一会话重入时可按请求重新设置
parameters.name: enable_thinking

parameters.help_en: The region ID for this resource operation
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: The SSE event stream. Each frame starts with data: and ends with a blank line. Continue reading until a terminal state is reached
schema.description_zh: SSE 事件流。每个 frame 以 data: 开头并以空行结束；请持续读取直到业务终态
